template.name: Sports Clinic App: install page wording

xpath.t: Full screen, an icon on your home screen, instant opening. Health data is never stored on the device.
Without a connection the app only shows an offline page: no team or player data is kept on the device.

xpath.t: Le Fit Crew needs a connection to show teams and players. Your drafts stay on this device and come back when you return to the page.
